name: Illinois
eyebrow: ComEd · Ameren Illinois · Nicor Gas · Peoples Gas
short: Illinois has no open statewide heat pump rebate in 2026, so your utility matters. ComEd takes up to $2,000 off a heat pump and up to $750 off a heat pump water heater. Naperville's city electric utility pays up to $1,800 for a heat pump. Nicor Gas and Peoples Gas pay for gas furnaces and for sealing and insulating. Illinois Shines pays $70.37 or $80.77 per solar credit. Ameren Illinois amounts could not be confirmed, the state's HOMES and HEAR rebates have not launched, and the federal tax credits ended after 2025.
